notes: Ruling case (rule 11): the report ends in a first-person account, «قال شهدت عثمان بن عفان». The chain stops at Hudayn as the one who saw it; the rules do not settle whether his account is the transmission or whether it has an implicit transmitter.
Uthman and Ali speak inside the scene, so they are not written as links.
«هو أبو ساسان» is an editor's gloss for the same man: not a second link. «- المعنى -» is left out.
